name: The Sixth Doctor
oracle_text: Time Lord's Prerogative — Whenever you cast a historic spell, copy it, except the copy isn't legendary. This ability triggers only once each turn. (Artifacts, legendaries, and Sagas are historic. A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token.)
blocked_sentences: Time Lord's Prerogative — Whenever you cast a historic spell, copy it, except the copy isn't legendary. This ability triggers only once each turn

needs.what: an `except` modifier on `copy_spell` that removes the Legendary supertype from the copy (707.9b), so a copied legendary permanent spell resolves as a nonlegendary token and does not fall to the legend rule against the original
needs.why_existing_wont_do: copy_spell carries only amount, controller, new_targets, sid, spells, target and this_spell; put_copy_on_stack copies the original's characteristics unchanged. copy_permanent has `except`/`except_` but acts on a permanent on the battlefield, not a spell on the stack. The trigger itself is sayable (spell_cast with filter any_of Artifact / Legendary supertype / Saga subtype, max_per_turn 1), but dropping the except clause would make a legendary copy die to the legend rule
